detail.sql: SELECT 'debian_tracker' AS source, concat(t.release, ' ', t.status, CASE WHEN t.version <> '' THEN concat(' ', t.version) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN t.release = 'sid' AND t.status = 'fixed' THEN concat(CASE WHEN t.since = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN t.since > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', t.since, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', t.since, ']') END, CASE WHEN t.same_line = '0' THEN concat(' [not on the bookworm version line: ', t.line_note, ']') WHEN t.fix_newer = '0' THEN concat(' [not newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') ELSE concat(' [same version line, newer than bookworm ', t.bw_versions, ']') END) ELSE '' END) AS fact, t.note AS detail, t.since AS signal_date, CASE WHEN t.bw_versions <> '' THEN concat('fixed ', t.version, ' vs bookworm ', t.bw_versions) ELSE '' END AS versions FROM revisit_pg.rv3_tracker_now t JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = t.wait_id WHERE t.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel' UNION ALL SELECT 'upstream_link' AS source, concat(u.kind, CASE WHEN u.release_tags <> '' THEN concat(' contained in ', size(split(u.release_tags, ',')), ' release tags (latest listed ', split(u.release_tags, ',')[0], ')') ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN u.merged_at <> '' THEN concat(' merged ', u.merged_at) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN u.commit_date <> '' AND u.kind = 'gh_commit' THEN concat(' authored ', u.commit_date) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN u.tag_date = '' THEN '' WHEN u.tag_bound = 'at_most' THEN concat(' already released by ', u.tag_date, ' (the oldest of the newest tags listed)') ELSE concat(' first released ', u.tag_date) END, CASE WHEN u.qualifies = '1' THEN concat(' [counts as the fix: ', u.why, ']') ELSE concat(' [NOT the fix by the rule: ', u.why, ']') END, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END, ']') END) AS fact, u.url AS detail, CASE WHEN u.kind = 'gh_pull' THEN u.merged_at WHEN u.tag_date <> '' THEN u.tag_date ELSE u.commit_date END AS signal_date, '' AS versions FROM revisit_pg.rv3_upstream u JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = u.wait_id WHERE u.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel' UNION ALL SELECT 'upstream_branch' AS source, concat('fix on upstream release/', b.branch, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN ' branch: yes' ELSE ' branch: no' END, CASE WHEN b.met = '1' THEN CASE WHEN b.tag_date = '' THEN ' [date unknown: does not count as new]' WHEN b.tag_date > w.deferred_at THEN concat(' [new since the deferral: ', b.tag_date, ']') ELSE concat(' [already there when Debian deferred: ', b.tag_date, ']') END ELSE '' END) AS fact, concat('release tags: ', b.tags) AS detail, b.tag_date AS signal_date, '' AS versions FROM revisit_pg.rv3_branch_fix b JOIN revisit_pg.rv3_waits w ON w.wait_id = b.wait_id WHERE b.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel' UNION ALL SELECT 'upstream_releases' AS source, concat('latest stable release ', it.stable_versions[0], ' [no release date: context only]') AS fact, concat('recent: ', concat_ws(', ', slice(it.stable_versions, 1, 6))) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions FROM rv3_up.rm_libsixel LATERAL VIEW explode(items) i AS it WHERE lower(it.name) = 'libsixel' UNION ALL SELECT 'osv' AS source, concat(o.id, ' modified ', substr(o.modified, 1, 10), ' [no date for when the fix appeared: context only]') AS fact, substr(to_json(o.affected), 1, 700) AS detail, '' AS signal_date, '' AS versions FROM rv3_up.osv_cve_2022_29977 o UNION ALL SELECT 'deferral_record' AS source, concat('deferred ', w.deferred_at) AS fact, concat('condition at deferral: ', w.condition_at_deferral, ' || condition now: ', w.condition_now) AS detail, w.deferred_at AS signal_date, '' AS versions FROM revisit_pg.rv3_waits w WHERE w.wait_id = 'CVE-2022-29977|libsixel'
